thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: Repeated Xid 13 / driver resets observed on gpu-node-12 (us-west-2a). Kernel softpanic + container crashes reported by runtime. Auto-creation of incident ticket #INC-2026-845.
sre-oncall: on it — pulling logs and telemetry. Adding cordon/drain checklist.
carla: any customer impact yet?
sre-oncall: Prometheus shows spike in OOM_killer and kubelet container restarts for pods on gpu-node-12 starting 1718209600. Latency for /v1/generate routes in the us-west cluster up ~120ms for affected pods. Not yet widespread.
alice: grabbing node console now (ssh to node). Running nvidia-smi and dmesg tails.
ben: tagging this as suspected ECC/XID-related, see previous runbooks. Will prep fallback routing group.
alice: nvidia-smi -q shows ECC errors increasing, GPU 0 reports Xid 13: "PCIe/Display engine error" repeated. dmesg shows: 
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:0b:00): 13, pid=23456, cpu_id=0, addr=0x00000000, channel 0000002d
[ 12346.123456] kernel: gpu-driver-kernel: softpanic: stack trace ...
```

sre-oncall: Good, that matches the driver reset signature. Recommended immediate steps: cordon node, drain non-critical GPU pods with graceful timeout 30s, shift traffic via routing policy to dedicated warmpool. Start telemetry snapshot (nv-host, syslog, kube-events).
carla: I'll notify customers on affected routing if we confirm impact. Which tenants are on that node?
ben: Tenant routing map -> gpu-node-12 hosts workloads for tenant-team-a (low-priority), testbench, and staging loads. No paid prod customers pinned, but PLG traffic might see errors.
sre-oncall: Proceeding to cordon/drain. Executing: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-12 && kubectl drain gpu-node-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30 --timeout=5m`
incident-bot: Command executed by sre-oncall at 1718210001: cordon succeeded, drain started. 6 pods evicted so far.
alice: Started capturing a pstore and nv-host logs to /var/log/incident/gpu-node-12-1718209876.tar.gz. Uploading to S3 for postmortem.
platform-eng: Suggest enabling immediate fallback to GPU-quantized model (lower memory) for generation routes to reduce KVCACHE pressure while we triage. Can we flip that?
sre-oncall: Yes — initiating route switch for /generate to model-small-quantized on the gateway for 1 minute canary then full switch. Doing now.
carla: Notified customer success to prepare an advisory if impact persists.
ben: Observed transient OOM in kvcache allocator in container logs: `kvcache: out of memory allocating 128MB for KV entries` — likely hitting worst-case batch pattern.
alice: After drain, node still logs intermittent driver resets during kernel unload. Looks like hardware-level ECC spikes. I'll request fleet quarantine for gpu-node-12 with tagging and a reboot attempt.
sre-oncall: Rebooting node now (graceful reboot). If resets persist post-reboot, escalate to hardware replacement via hw-ticket flow.
incident-bot: Reboot initiated by sre-oncall at 1718210232. Estimated down time ~3m.
carla: Customer CS update: low but noticeable increase in generation errors observed by some free-tier users — monitoring for reports.
ben: Telemetry snapshot uploaded. Key metrics: Xid spikes correlated with kernel stack traces near nv-host, ECC correctables rising by 2000 in last hour.
platform-eng: Adding quarantine label and draining more nodes from the same rack preemptively. We'll also shift warmpool capacity to us-west-2b.
sre-oncall: Reboot finished at 1718210345. Node came back but Xid 13 resumed within 60s. Kernel oops still present.
alice: Given immediate recurrence, marking node as unrecoverable for now. Creating hw-replacement ticket and draining remaining pods to other nodes.
carla: I'll prepare a brief customer-facing blurb: "We observed transient GPU driver instability in us-west causing elevated error rates for some generation requests. We mitigated via routing and node quarantine; no customer data loss. Follow-up with timeline to come." :thumbsup:
sre-oncall: Handoff to alice for hardware replacement coordination and postmortem. I'll remain available for any rollback to routes.
alice: Acknowledged — taking lead. I'll coordinate with on-call hardware ops and file the full postmortem once logs/S3 dump processed.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-845 updated: severity -> S2, status -> mitigated (routing fallback applied, node quarantined).
sre-oncall: Closing on-call shift in 30m; leaving notes in the ticket. If anything flares, ping @sre-oncall.
carla: Thanks team. Good quick work.
ben: +1. Adding follow-up items: increase kvcache OOM alert sensitivity, add automated model-fallback for Xid signature, and add node-level ECC threshold alarms.
alice: Will add hardware replacement timeline to the ticket and tag owners.
carla: End of thread for now.
